बॉलीवुड के दिग्गज एक्टर और डायरेक्टर टिन्नू आनंद के फैंस के लिए आई बेहद राहत भरी खबर! 🩺❤️

81 साल के अभिनेता अपने घर में रात के समय लाइट बंद होने की वजह से अचानक गिर पड़े थे। शुरुआत में चोट का अंदाजा नहीं हुआ, पर अगली सुबह बेटी उन्हें मुंबई के Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital ले गई। CT scan में खुलासा हुआ कि उनकी 5 पसलियां टूट गई हैं और lung भी puncture हुआ है।

अस्पताल के ICU में पूरे 14 दिन बिताने के बाद गुरुवार को उन्हें आखिरकार डिस्चार्ज कर दिया गया है। टिन्नू जी ने बताया कि वह अब बहुत बेहतर महसूस कर रहे हैं। फिलहाल वह घर पर रहकर complete bed rest कर रहे हैं और उनकी physiotherapy चल रही है। रिकवरी और डॉक्टरों की सलाह के बाद वह अगले महीने दो South films की शूटिंग शुरू करने की उम्मीद जता रहे हैं। 🙏

Shahenshah और Kaalia जैसी ब्लॉकबस्टर फिल्में बनाने वाले टिन्नू आनंद के लिए कमेंट्स में 'Get Well Soon' जरूर लिखें! 👇

ctx.title: Tinnu Anand discharged from hospital after 14 days, recovering at home following five fractured ribs and punctured lung
ctx.summary: Tinnu Anand says he recovering from rib injury sustained during a fall. He was discharged from Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital in Mumbai.
ctx.text:
Veteran actor-filmmaker Tinnu Anand , who suffered five fractured ribs and a punctured lung after a fall, says he has been discharged from the hospital and recovering at home. He was discharged from Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital in suburban Mumbai on Thursday, where he was admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) following the accident.
Speaking to PTI, the actor shared an update on his health and said he was feeling much better. "I've come home after 14 days and I'm much better now. I'm supposed to recover in the bed, till the doctors says, 'You're okay to go out'," he said.
The 81-year-old director said he had a fall at his residence. Recalling how the accident happened, Tinnu said he fell while walking around his house at night when the lights were switched off. He did not immediately realise the extent of his injuries and only learnt about the fractures the following morning.
"I was walking in the night and the lights were not on, and suddenly I fell down and went to sleep after that. The next morning, I came to know that I've suffered a fracture so my daughter took me to the hospital. After the CT scan, we learnt that I've got five fractures. I don't remember how I spend that time but I'm okay now," he said.
The actor has been advised complete bed rest as he continues his recovery. He is also undergoing physiotherapy at home and is taking time to regain his strength following the injuries. "I'm resting well at home," he said, adding that he hopes to resume work on two South-language films sometime next month, depending on his recovery and his doctors' advice.
Tinnu Anand has been a part of the Hindi film industry for decades, wearing several hats as an actor, filmmaker, writer and director. The son of veteran screenwriter Inder Raj Anand, he comes from a family with deep roots in cinema. While a younger generation of viewers may recognise him from films such as Salaar, Ghajini, Dabangg and Merry Christmas, the filmmaker is equally remembered for his work behind the camera. As an actor, his filmography also includes Agneepath, Khiladi, Damini, Kohra, Krantiveer, Trimurti, China Gate, Saathiya and Bluffmaster. As a filmmaker, he has also directed several films starring Amitabh Bachchan , including Kaalia, Shahenshah, Main Azaad Hoon and Major Saab.
